classification: SYNTHETIC-DATA REFERENCE IMPLEMENTATION — not CDF production. Synthetic scenario; expectations hand-derived by W-C from catalogue_v13.json (PROPOSED).
author: W-C

semantics.expected: expected.actual and expected.expected_steps are the complete Layer A and Layer B lists (catalogue order); note must match exactly (absent = no note); evidence_event_id is checked where given, and every COMPLETED step must cite an input event of one of its completion types (completion_event_type, or a pattern of completion_any_of; with completion_target SELF the event must name the object itself). Other keys are subset checks.
semantics.must_not: '<symbol> on <step_id>' (symbol ✔ ● ○; checked on the resolver state and on the built view) | 'L1' (no Level 1) | 'L1 <sub-state>' | 'L1 ✔ on <stage>' | 'derived.<key>' (false or null) | 'deadline.at' (every at is null) | 'L1 in the <CLASS> view' | '<step_id> in the <CLASS> view'
semantics.variants: A variant applies, in order: events (full replacement), events_add (appended), events_replace (payload replaced by event_id), procedural_object_patch (shallow merge), case_patch (shallow merge; null deletes the key). variant.expected inherits l1 and notice_location from the base scenario when it does not state them; every other key is the variant's own.
